acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

The mass spectrometer acquired data throughout the elution process and operated in a data dependent scheme with full MS scans acquired, followed by up to 10 successive MS/MS HCD-fragmentations on the most abundant ions detected.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Briefly, protein disulfide bonds were reduced and alkylated by adding a final concentration of 20mM TCEP and 50mM chloroacetamide and heating the samples 5 minutes at 95°C.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Briefly, protein disulfide bonds were reduced and alkylated by adding a final concentration of 20mM TCEP and 50mM chloroacetamide and heating the samples 5 minutes at 95°C.

collision_energy.evidence: HCD normalized collision energy (NCE) was set at 27% and MS/MS scan resolution was set at 17 500 with AGC target 1.105 within 60ms MIIT.

fractionation_method.evidence: Digested peptides were then eluted by centrifugation, and fractionated by strong cation exchange (SCX) StageTips in 5 fractions and dried in a speedvac.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer acquired data throughout the elution process and operated in a data dependent scheme with full MS scans acquired, followed by up to 10 successive MS/MS HCD-fragmentations on the most abundant ions detected.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: 1 µl of each fraction were concentrated and washed on a C18 reverse-phase precolumn (3 m particle size, 100 A˚ pore size, 75 m inner diameter, 2 cm length, Thermo Fischer Scientific).

labeling.evidence: Label-free protein quantification (LFQ) was done using both unique and razor peptides.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry analyses were performed on an U3000 RSLC nanoflow-HPLC system coupled to a Q-Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (both from Thermo Fisher Scientific).
